quality_notes: ONS residence-basis environmental accounts are kept distinct from DESNZ territorial/local-authority and Defra consumption-footprint statistics.
ONS revision and correction metadata are retained rather than silently treating superseded data as current.
DfT RTFO fifth-provisional figures remain provisional and are not treated as final observations.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grants and product eligibility remain scheme-administration evidence rather than measured greenhouse-gas reductions.
UK ETS factors, allowances, registry allocations and market data remain distinct from direct physical-emissions measurements.
Defra consumption-footprint corrections dated 7 and 24 July 2026 are preserved, and no consumption estimate is assigned to a parcel.
No individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
